summary: Satellos Bioscience furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a September 9, 2026 press release announcing that the World Health Organization assigned the International Nonproprietary Name (INN) 'forazapadin' to its lead oral small molecule candidate previously designated SAT-3247, an AAK1 inhibitor for Duchenne muscular dystrophy. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is a routine product-naming/clinical-development update, with management noting expected completion of BASECAMP enrollment this quarter and data in Q4 2026.
